verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the error-workflow feature (n8n-docs-5). It is a separate workflow that n8n runs when another workflow's execution fails, which is a narrow form of one workflow invoking another. Webhook and MCP Server Trigger nodes (n8n-docs-21, n8n-docs-19) could let workflows be triggered externally, but nothing shows them used for workflow-to-workflow composition. Missing for 10: any documented sub-workflow or execute-workflow call mechanism, passing inputs and outputs between parent and child workflows, reusable module or library patterns, and hands-on corroboration.
